I recolored this so that I'd have a barn that looked nice with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21180]Lavender Craftables[/url] I made. The mod originally only offered Lavender but I have added additional colors now.

I also toned down the hay. If you do not like this option you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to turn this off. You can also use the config to turn off the "clean" version of the barns and keep just the recolors. 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/XJVRWXm.png[/img]

This is a recolor for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66341516?tab=user+files]Erasercat's Cuter Coop & Barn[/url]. Erasercat opened permissions on their mods before leaving. See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3833]here[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5667]here[/url]﻿.  As well as an unoffical update [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15053]here[/url] that also mentions the open permissions. 

Again thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/140245483]Vin[/url] for letting me use the color palette from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17323]Lavender Dreams[/url]. I highly recommend downloading their mod!
